setup.title: Create your project
setup.description: Choose a name and the local folder your agents will work in.
setup.name: Project name
setup.folderHelp: Choose the folder of an existing git repository. Nothing is cloned or uploaded.
setup.folderHelpChosen: Agents work in this folder. Nothing is cloned or uploaded.
setup.detectedFromFolder: GitHub is detected from the folder
setup.detectedFromFolderDetail: Orchester reads the folder’s git remote (origin) and asks the GitHub CLI (gh) which account is signed in. GitHub is optional: without it, pull request steps are unavailable.

ownership.title: A home for this project’s work
ownership.detail: Tasks, agent profiles, instructions, tools, secrets and connections stay in this project. You can import independent copies from another project later.
ownership.detailNamed: Tasks, agent profiles, instructions, tools, secrets and connections stay in {{name}}. You can import independent copies from another project later.

bar.chooseFolder: Choose the project folder to continue.
bar.needsRepository: The project folder must be a git repository to continue.
bar.explanation: Creates the project in the repository’s .orchester folder and opens it.

github.title: GitHub repository
github.addConnectionUnavailable: Add the GitHub connection once the project exists, in its Connections.
github.runThis: Run this in a terminal, then check again.

heading.notSignedIn: gh is not signed in to {{host}}
heading.notRepository: This folder is not a git repository
heading.gitFailed: Couldn’t read the folder’s git remotes
heading.emptyRepository: The repository has no default branch yet

note.detected: {{project}} will expect {{account}}. Orchester uses gh’s own sign-in and never stores or sees a token.
note.detectedUnnamed: This project will expect {{account}}. Orchester uses gh’s own sign-in and never stores or sees a token.
note.detecting: Reading the folder’s git remote and asking gh about the repository. You can already create the project.
note.noRemote: You can create the project. Pull request steps and the Pull requests screen stay unavailable until the folder has a GitHub remote.
note.notGitHub: Pull request steps will be unavailable. If this is a GitHub Enterprise host, add a GitHub connection for it, then check again.
note.ghNotFound: Orchester reaches GitHub only through gh. Install it or choose its program file, then check again. You can create the project now.
note.notSignedIn: Run this in a terminal, then check again. Orchester never signs in for you.
note.wrongAccount: Switch gh back to {{expected}} in a terminal and check again, or make {{project}} expect {{active}}. Orchester never switches gh accounts; pull requests can’t be created until they match.
note.wrongAccountUnnamed: Switch gh back to {{expected}} in a terminal and check again, or make this project expect {{active}}. Orchester never switches gh accounts; pull requests can’t be created until they match.
note.noAccess: GitHub found no repository this account can read. Ask the owner for access, or switch accounts in gh, then check again.
note.unrecognized: gh answered in a format Orchester doesn’t recognise. Update gh, then check again. Details are in the log.
note.unrecognizedVersion: gh {{version}} answered in a format Orchester doesn’t recognise. Update gh, then check again. Details are in the log.
note.notRepository: Runs work in git worktrees, so the project folder must be a git repository. Initialise it in a terminal, or choose another folder, then check again. Create project & continue stays disabled until then.
note.missingScope: gh is signed in as {{account}} without the {{scope}} scope that Orchester needs to read and create pull requests. Add it in a terminal, then check again. You can create the project now.
note.gitFailed: git couldn’t read the folder’s remotes. Make sure git is installed, then check again.
note.couldNotRun: gh could not be started or did not answer in time. Check again.
note.unreachable: gh couldn’t reach {{host}}. Check the network, then check again.
note.rateLimited: GitHub’s API rate limit is used up. Check again later.
note.emptyRepository: Push a first commit to the repository, then check again.

access.title: Change GitHub account or access
access.detail: Orchester uses the account gh is signed in to on this computer. It never signs in, switches accounts or sees your token.
access.otherDetail: Sign in once, then switch. gh accounts are shared by every project on this computer.
access.accessDetail: Orchester needs the {{scope}} scope. If gh doesn’t have it, add it.
access.runHint: Run these in a terminal, then check again.
